view_frame: Front view (XZ) shows the wheel face with X as horizontal width and Z as vertical height. Right view (YZ) shows the side profile with Y as depth (thickness) and Z as height. The wheel is centered at the origin (0,0,0) in the world frame.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). Outer radius 60 mm, inner radius 50 mm (60 - 10). Extends from Y = -4 mm to Y = +4 mm.
features.evidence: Front view shows two concentric circles. Right view shows a rectangle of height 120 mm and width 8 mm. Label 'OD 120 mm; thickness 8 mm'.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). Radius 15 mm. Extends from Y = -4 mm to Y = +4 mm.
features.evidence: Front view shows a central circle. Right view shows the same thickness as the rim.

features.axis_or_plane: Radial in XZ plane, extruded along Y
features.placement: 8 spokes arranged radially at 45-degree intervals. Each spoke connects the hub (radius 15 mm) to the rim (radius 50 mm). Extends from Y = -4 mm to Y = +4 mm.
features.evidence: Front view shows 8 radial lines connecting the hub to the rim. Label '8 spokes'.

connections: Spokes connect the hub to the rim.
All components share the same thickness (8 mm) and are centered on the Y-axis.
edit_rules: Changing OD affects rim outer radius and spoke length.
Changing thickness affects the Y-dimension of all components.
Changing spoke count requires re-distributing spokes radially.
Changing hub diameter affects spoke length and inner connection point.
unresolved: Rim width (radial thickness) is not explicitly dimensioned; assumed 10 mm.
